description: This file defines the ClientInterface interface for GuzzleHttp, specifying methods for sending HTTP requests synchronously and asynchronously, and for retrieving client configuration options. It also includes constants and type hints relevant to HTTP request handling.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request synchronously and returns a ResponseInterface object; may throw a GuzzleException.

methods.name: sendAsync
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request asynchronously and returns a PromiseInterface.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Creates and sends an HTTP request based on the specified method, URI, and options; returns a ResponseInterface.

methods.name: requestAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP request with specified method, URI, and options; returns a PromiseInterface.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration option for the client; may be deprecated in future versions.
